kjv: pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.

words.word: whom dost thou pass in beauty

occurrences.text: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.
